com.invoiceparserpro/capability.description: Replace an invoice's observed billing and settlement exchange rates, date and note. Optional values left out are cleared. Original invoice amounts remain unchanged; this records information without initiating payment. Review and confirm the exact change first. The preview expires after five minutes. Preview only; nothing is applied until you confirm.
examples: For our selected fictional practice invoice, preview recording base currency USD, observed billing rate 1.08, settlement rate 1.10, settlement date 2026-10-01 and note Practice exchange-rate annotation. Show the full replacement and confirm this records information without initiating payment, then wait for my confirmation.

description: Prepare replacing the observed billing/settlement rates and optional date/note. Omitted optional fields are cleared; original invoice amounts remain. No payment is initiated. Requires confirmation. This returns an exact preview and a five-minute confirmation token; it does not apply the change.
name: preview_set_invoice_settlement
title: Preview: Record invoice exchange rates
